**Both fixes are confirmed. No new source blocker.**

- **Partial-payment text (`payment-facts.ts:30`):** "سُجل سداد جزئي؛ علاقات توظيف بها متبقٍ: ⁨١⁩." The count follows its own label and a colon, wrapped in FSI/PDI (`\u2068…\u2069`), so no letter joins the digit and it can't render as "لا".
- **Stage 6 copy:**
  - The locked caption (`stage-facts.ts:41`) and the `currentStage === 5` hint (`PayrollStepper.tsx:29`) now say "معروضة أدناه حسب الصلاحية/صلاحيتك". The hint keeps "وجود مسير نهائي لا يعني أنه صُرف".
  - Stage 5 is the current stage only when the run is locked with `final_output_id`, which is exactly when the payment panel renders. So the "below" reference is accurate.
  - Superseded keeps "راجع المخرج البديل", and a locked run without an output keeps its own text.
- **Unchanged:** primary, context, authority, audit and financial paths. These are text-only edits.

**Final source verdict:** the stage-facts and recorded-payment candidate is accepted at source level.

**Remaining gates:**
- **Pixels:** the existing screenshots predate this text change, so they don't prove it. Full theme, reference and parent match is **NOT VISUALLY VERIFIED**. The open differences are the 3-column described cards versus the six compact markers, and the separate payment panel.
- **Runtime:**
  - hover and touch prefetch;
  - the authenticated full parent;
  - real accounts and audit end to end;
  - real roles and providers;
  - financial acceptance.
- **Recovery:** the owner's A/B choice is untouched.
- **Scope:** D16 and extras deferred.
- **Closure:** whole R7 and R0–R8 open, with no task-speed or phase claim.
